required_tests_and_fixtures: exact owner chat enable accepted in dry-run
persistent control artifact write/read round trip
rollback-if-disable-fails restores backup or fails closed
post-enable observation dry-run emits six probe plan and abort gates
status_readback_behavior: must read persisted control artifact and return enabled/scope/owner/channel/agent/authority/rollback/fail_closed fields
enable_behavior: must write only the M10A control artifact/flag for owner Telegram direct scope 8495203551 with production_authority=false and broad_enforcement=false
disable_off_switch_behavior: must set m10a_enabled=false and contract_decision_enforcement=false with exact readback
operator_stop_behavior: must map explicit operator stop to disable/off-switch and fail-closed readback
rollback_behavior: if disable/readback fails, restore from approved backup path or hold before restart/traffic
observation_behavior: must run or schedule six read-only probes at five-minute cadence and emit PASS/HOLD/FAIL closeout
staged_install_requirement: source-ready/no-apply first; subsequent staged install requires explicit owner approval; Gateway restart requires separate approval if needed
approval_boundary: owner Telegram direct M10A contract-decision enforcement only; no Web UI/LAN/browser/external-send/write-tool/memory/Context Bridge/broad enforcement authority
